title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（深沢徹研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Fukasawa Toru)
educationalGoal:
Educational programs focusing on basic knowledge and skills in the fields of electrical engineering and electronics, which are highly important, develop highly creative electrical and electronics engineers who have acquired problem-finding, solving, and applied skills.
General theme: Antenna element, Antenna measurement, Antenna implementation
advice:
This subject is the final subject of the project design process, including an introduction to project design, and is positioned as a subject that integrates the items learned in all subjects. The aim is to review basic subjects and acquire advanced expertise through experiments and theoretical studies on project themes.

Have their own project theme and work alone or in groups. Hold weekly meetings and report on progress with technical reports.

The annual schedule is as follows.
1st period: Determine the project theme to be implemented and create a project proposal. Provide project progress report at the end of the semester. It will be announced at the mid-term presentation in July.
2nd period: Review the project proposal and modify if necessary. Submit a project progress report at the end of the semester. Is compiled into a project report and presented at the public presentation examination committee.

The main theme includes: The project theme is in parentheses.
(1) Antenna element
(2) Antenna measurement
(3) Antenna implementation

achievementLevels.ideal:
Acquire sufficient knowledge about wireless communication technology and antenna technology.
Achieve creative results and report to the public presentation examination committee.
Those who plan to go on to graduate school present their research results at academic conferences.
achievementLevels.standard:
Have knowledge of wireless communication technology and antenna technology.
The results can be reported at the public presentation examination committee.
